units.source_text: 匂亲王听说侍从来了，不胜悲痛。

en.t: When Prince Niou heard that Jijuu had come, he was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 因为这件事太不好意思，所以没有告诉二女公子。

en.t: Because the matter was too embarrassing, he had not told the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 匂亲王来到正殿上，叫侍从在廊前下车。

en.t: Prince Niou went to the main hall and had Jijuu get out of her carriage before the corridor.

units.source_text: 他向她详细探问浮舟临终以前的情状，侍从把小姐那一时期悲伤愁叹之状，以及那天晚上哭泣之状，一一告诉了他。

en.t: He questioned her in detail about Ukifune's condition before her final hour, and Jijuu told him one by one how the young lady had grieved and sighed during that time, and how she had wept that night.

units.source_text: 她说：“小姐异常沉默，对万事都无精打采。

en.t: She said, "The young lady was unusually silent and had no spirit for anything.

units.source_text: 虽有忧患之事，亦不大肯告诉人，只是闷在自己心里。

en.t: Even when she had troubles and anxieties, she would hardly tell anyone, but kept everything shut up in her own heart.

units.source_text: 想是因此之故，临终连遗言也没有。

en.t: Perhaps because of that, she left not even a final message at the end.

units.source_text: 她如此痛下决心，实在做梦也想不到。”

en.t: I never dreamed that she would make such a desperate decision."

units.source_text: 她报告得很详细，匂亲王听了越发悲伤，推想浮舟心情，怪她何不听天由命，随俗沉浮，而要如此痛下决心，投身溺水呢？

en.t: Her account was very detailed, and Prince Niou grew still more sorrowful as he listened. Imagining Ukifune's feelings, he wondered bitterly why she had not left things to fate and drifted with the world, instead of resolving so desperately to throw herself into the water.

units.source_text: 又念当时如果看见她投水，拦腰抱住，多么好呢！

en.t: He also thought how good it would have been if, at that moment, he had seen her throw herself in and had caught her around the waist.

units.source_text: 便觉心痛如捣，然而现已无法挽回了。

en.t: His heart felt as if it were being pounded with pain, yet now there was no way to undo it.

units.source_text: 侍从也说：“当她烧毁书信之时，我们何以不加注意，实在太疏忽了。”

en.t: Jijuu also said, "When she burned the letters, why did we not pay closer attention? We were truly too careless."

units.source_text: 她回答匂亲王的问话，谈了一夜，直到天明。

en.t: She answered Prince Niou's questions and talked through the whole night until dawn.

units.source_text: 又把浮舟写在诵经卷数单上答复母亲的绝命诗读给他听。

en.t: She also read aloud to him the death poem Ukifune had written to answer her mother on the list of sutra recitations.

units.source_text: 匂亲王向来对这侍从并不十分注目，此时也觉得可亲可爱，对她说道：“你今后就在此间供职如何？

en.t: Prince Niou had never paid much attention to this Jijuu before, but now he found her dear and endearing, and said to her, "How would it be if you served here from now on?

units.source_text: 你对我家夫人也不是生疏的。”

en.t: You are not a stranger to my lady either."

units.source_text: 侍从答道：“我虽欲在此供职，但心中悲痛未已。

en.t: Jijuu replied, "Although I would like to serve here, the grief in my heart has not yet ended.

units.source_text: 且待七七过后再说吧。”

en.t: Please let us wait until the forty-nine days have passed before speaking of it again."

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“希望你再来。”

en.t: Prince Niou said, "I hope you will come again."

units.source_text: 他连此人也觉得依依不舍。

en.t: He felt reluctant to part even from her.

units.source_text: 破晓之时，侍从言归，匂亲王把以前为浮舟置办的栉箱一套和衣箱一套赏赐了她。

en.t: At daybreak, when Jijuu said she would return, Prince Niou gave her a set of comb boxes and a set of clothing boxes that he had earlier prepared for Ukifune.

units.source_text: 他为浮舟置办的器物甚多，但赏赐侍从亦不宜太丰，所以只把与她身份相称之物送她。

en.t: He had prepared many objects for Ukifune, but it would not be proper to give Jijuu too lavish a reward, so he sent her only things suited to her rank.

units.source_text: 侍从来此，想不到会受赏，如今带了这许多东西回去，生怕同辈看到了诧怪，倒是麻烦之事。

en.t: Jijuu had not expected to receive gifts when she came here, and now, taking so many things back, she feared that her companions would see them and be suspicious, which would only make trouble.

units.source_text: 因此她很为难，然而不好意思退回，只得带着回去。

en.t: For that reason she was greatly troubled, but she was too embarrassed to return them and had no choice but to take them back with her.

units.source_text: 到了山庄，与右近二人悄悄地打开来看。

en.t: When she reached the mountain villa, she and Ukon quietly opened them together to look inside.

units.source_text: 每逢寂寞无聊之时，看到这许多巧妙精致、新颖可爱的东西，不觉悲从中来，相与泣下。

en.t: Whenever they felt lonely and listless, seeing so many clever, exquisite, fresh, and charming things made sorrow well up within them, and they wept together.

units.source_text: 衣服也都是很华丽的。

en.t: The clothing, too, was all very splendid.

units.source_text: “在此丧忌之中，怎样隐藏这些东西呢？”

en.t: "How can we hide these things during this period of mourning?"

units.source_text: 两人相与愁叹。

en.t: The two of them lamented together in distress.
